qa.scopeNote: Local Playwright and Chromium, fixed November 22 evening forecast. All five widths passed home selection, comparison, guide URL, reversal, and expired snapshot. No JavaScript leaves direct NOAA/NWS links. axe-core reported zero WCAG A/AA violations in the regional panel at 390 px with the comparison open. Live feeds, field Web Vitals and visitor outcomes require separate evidence.
qa.headlinePosition: 390px viewport, selected Bay City, measured from document top: 1067px before and 472px after. At 1280px: 777px before and 376px after.
qa.foundry: Same-hour weather and guide, missing comparison clouds, expired response and canonical preservation. Foundry 0.3 reported BEHAVIOR_DEMONSTRATED. The replay is tests/aurora-two-region.test.js.

technology: Semantic HTML and CSS carry the first decision. Browser JavaScript joins the two existing grids on one timestamp. Retain the existing Node response. Python, Java and Rust would add runtime or deployment work without supplying new evidence. Revisit only if data validation or profiling identifies a bottleneck.
designReview: Compared an interactive statewide map with a local-hour comparison. Michigan After Dark answers where to go, and Snow Totals ranks reported accumulations. Here the visitor keeps one reference hour and asks what the northern sky could look like in two places. Reverting the PR restores the original presentation.
